aaa_equivalent: UE5 PCG World Partition biome graph / Witcher 3 region splitter
weakness: Voronoi is fixed-weight — no biome-count rebalancing based on temperature/moisture gradients; flatten zones are circular only.
upgrade: Climate-driven Voronoi weighting; rectangular flatten zones for linear building footprints.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea frost-heave micro-relief
weakness: Python loop over n_centers for distance (O(N*H*W)) — scales poorly; uses np.random.RandomState (legacy); no orientation (real stone stripes align with slope).
upgrade: Use KDTree or broadcast to single numpy op; add slope-aligned striping.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Desert/Arid node
weakness: Pure-numpy box filter via _box_filter_2d has O(H*W) Python loop — slow on 1k+ grids.
upgrade: Use np.cumsum-based vectorized integral-image computation.

aaa_equivalent: Hydrological seepage analysis (Houdini/Arcgis)
weakness: Layer boundaries placed by elevation quantization — real geology uses stratigraphic dip, not level contours. Narrow bands (exp/0.001) can miss entirely at some resolutions.
upgrade: Use actual stratigraphy (from terrain_stratigraphy) rather than quantized elevation.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Slump / Skyrim landslide scars
weakness: Scar mask is concentric circle (uphill vs downhill not asymmetric); deposit placement uses gradient at origin only — doesn't flow along actual descent path.
upgrade: Trace downslope path and distribute deposits along travel line; elongate scar uphill only.

aaa_equivalent: Yellowstone travertine terraces reference (Hell Let Loose / Horizon)
weakness: Perfect circular rings; real travertine is asymmetric (downhill-biased, irregular ridges).
upgrade: Skew rings downhill; perturb ring_r by noise.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West coral reef authoring
weakness: Uniform reef around whole coast; real reefs are biased toward warm/shallow-gradient shores.
upgrade: Gate by tidal_range and distance-from-land to avoid reefs in deep-water-hugging coasts.

aaa_equivalent: Honeycomb weathering decals (Megascans)
weakness: 50 cavities over full heightmap is sparse — honeycomb weathering is by definition dense; cavity depth flat (no interior texture).
upgrade: Scale cavity count with steep area; layer micro+macro cavities.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Stratify + Tilt nodes combined
weakness: Adds folds linearly — real tectonic folds scale fold amplitude with cumulative strain and plunge along axis.
upgrade: Add plunging-fold support (amplitude varies along strike).

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Heightfield carve + side tributary erosion (e.g. RDR2 Grand Canyon, Uncharted Lost Legacy canyons)
weakness: Canyon is a straight rectilinear trench along X with only mild y-offset wall noise; no meander, no talus slopes, no stratified horizontal rock layers, and 'side caves' are only metadata dicts with zero actual mesh carved into the walls.
upgrade: Build canyon centerline via meandering spline, carve walls from a base heightmap with multi-octave stratified erosion, generate real boolean cave voids at each side cave, and add scree/debris cones at wall bases.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West / Genshin waterfall with volumetric water plume, pool caustics, and mist VFX; Gaea water-carving layer.
weakness: Ledges are literally single quads (no side/bottom faces), pool is a crude 16-sided fan triangle disc with no lip or undercut, 'cave behind' is pure metadata with no geometry carved, and there is no water mesh, no plunge basin curvature, and no erosion behind/below the falls.
upgrade: Generate real boxed ledges with front undercuts, carve a real cave void behind the flow with SDF boolean, build a volumetric water plume mesh (tapered prism, not plane) and a contoured plunge pool with distinct lip, and output mist emitter positions.

aaa_equivalent: Uncharted / Tomb Raider climbable cliff with ledge kit, or UE Landscape Layer Blend with overhang tool.
weakness: Base cliff is still a single planar heightfield tilted at the top (not true overhangs with undercut), cave entrances are metadata only with no holes punched in the face, and ledge ribbon is a flat two-vertex strip with no thickness or railings/handholds.
upgrade: Use a displaced volumetric slab (front + top + underside stitched) so overhang becomes a real shelf, boolean-carve cave entrances through the face, and extrude the ledge into a 3D walkable shelf with chamfered edge.

aaa_equivalent: Far Cry/Witcher 3 bog biome with hummock stamps, standing water masks, and island dry-zone classification.
weakness: Resolution scales as size/2 (so a 50m swamp is only 25x25 = 625 quads = ~2m quads) which is too coarse for AAA; no channel/river carving, no peat/hammock micro-morphology, and water is tagged via material only — there is no actual water plane mesh.
upgrade: Raise resolution to sub-meter, carve drainage channels with hydraulic erosion pass, emit a separate water surface mesh aligned to water_level, and output root/reed scatter masks instead of just material IDs.

aaa_equivalent: Tomb Raider/Uncharted cenote or Sima de las Cotorras with vertical walls, vegetation shelves, and water pool bottom.
weakness: Walls are still rotationally symmetric (only 15% narrowing at bottom, no undercuts or bell shape), rubble boxes are axis-aligned and identical topology, the bottom cave is metadata-only with no actual opening cut into the wall, and there is no water/vegetation shelf despite sinkholes typically having both.
upgrade: Allow non-axisymmetric radius profile (bell or hourglass), boolean-carve the bottom cave into the wall mesh, scatter rocks with varied topology and rotation, and add a mid-depth vegetation shelf ring.

aaa_equivalent: Avatar/Horizon floating islands or Zelda TOTK sky islands; Houdini Voronoi-fractured rock clusters.
weakness: Chain 'links' are open cylindrical shafts stacked vertically (not interlocked torus rings), rocks are fundamentally noisy spheres with no sharp fractured planes or crystalline protrusions, undersides look identical to tops (same material differentiation is purely tag-based), and there is no island flat top / grass zone typical of fantasy float rocks.
upgrade: Replace sphere base with Voronoi-fractured polyhedra giving flat facets, differentiate top via flattened cap + grass mask, make chain links actual torus primitives interlocking at 90-degree alternation, and add crystal vein mesh geometry rather than just material tag.

aaa_equivalent: God of War Ragnarok ice caves / Horizon FW Cauldrons with volumetric ice, parallax refraction, and icicle clusters.
weakness: Stalactite material banding uses `kt` variable that is actually the OUTER loop counter `k` from a previous loop (variable captured incorrectly — bug: `kt` in the mat_indices block references the last stalactite's last ring k/cone_rings, not current face position), 'refraction zones' are randomly sampled metadata disconnected from the actual curvature classification applied to faces, ice wall is a flat displaced plane (no thickness), and there is no floor/stalagmite, no pool, no volumetric ice.
upgrade: Fix the kt-scoping bug so banding tracks current ring properly; extrude the ice wall into a volume with frosted interior; add matching stalagmites and frozen pool mesh; derive refraction_zones from the actual high-curvature face centers rather than random sampling.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Burning Shores lava channels or Kilauea reference with pahoehoe crust folds and incandescent fissures.
weakness: Flow is still a single-strip ribbon — no branching, no pillow/tube morphology, no solidification fingers; crust edges are symmetric with simple linear height profile, no a'a vs pahoehoe variation; lava surface is the same continuous grid as the rock banks with no lip or embankment discontinuity; heat zones are uniformly distributed along t with no flow-physics grounding.
upgrade: Replace ribbon with a 2D flow-accumulation field producing branching channels, model crust as a separate floating shell above a lower hot-lava surface (two meshes) with broken crust patches, and derive heat_zones from channel-width narrowings/drop points instead of uniform sampling.

aaa_equivalent: Megascans cliff scans / Quixel rock kit / Gaea Rock node
weakness: Single Gaussian-noise pass with sinusoidal mask — no fracture planes, no strata layering, no overhangs. AAA cliffs use scanned heightfields or rule-based joint systems.
upgrade: Add stacked strata noise, fault-plane displacement, overhang support (Y can exceed 0.3*sin curve), and weathered talus at base.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Nanite cave kit / Skyrim cave entrance module
weakness: Symmetric semicircular arch, uniform extrusion — no irregular mouth shape, no stalactites/lintel erosion, no interior branching.
upgrade: Randomize arch shape (non-semicircle), vary ring profile along depth, add debris apron + rock framing.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape layer blend / Witcher 3 biome transition
weakness: Flat plane with trivial Gaussian bumps. Blend is linear across x. No actual biome-specific geometry (roots, moss hummocks, puddles).
upgrade: Height should sample from biome-specific heightmap; blend factor should be noise-displaced not straight-linear.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West waterfall / RDR2 volumetric cascade
weakness: Curtain is a flat-ish two-row strip (checks feedback_waterfall_must_have_volume — this IS almost flat). Pool is a single-segment fan disk. No mist zone, no foam edge, no thickness taper — exactly the failure mode called out in memory.
upgrade: Curtain needs front curvature >=3 segments, thickness taper top->bottom, plunge pool needs bowl not flat disc. Integrate with terrain_waterfalls_volumetric profile.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Edge Detection / Gaea Slope mask with clustering
weakness: Python for-loop flood-fill is O(N) but slow on large grids; Dr. cluster rotation uses only center cell gradient (not PCA over cluster); no confidence/overlap score.
upgrade: Switch to scipy.ndimage.label for O(HW) label pass and fit oriented bounding box via PCA of cluster cells for rotation.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Heightfield Erode Thermal / Gaea Thermal node
weakness: Pure-Python double loop is 100x slower than a numpy vectorized version; uses 4-neighborhood only (no diagonals) so scree fans look axis-aligned; no angle-of-repose per-material layer; returns .tolist() blowing memory for 512+ maps.
upgrade: Vectorize with numpy shift operations (np.roll + max), add 8-neighborhood with sqrt(2) distance scaling, and expose per-cell talus from a mask for multi-material slopes.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea canvas sampler at world window
weakness: Thin wrapper around generate_heightmap; assumes single-scale noise; no macro/meso/micro composition.
upgrade: Compose tectonic plates + regional distortion + local detail as separate noise layers (Gaea Mountain+Hills+Rocks).

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Erosion2 / World Machine Erosion
weakness: Default 1000 hydraulic iterations is far below AAA (Gaea 10k+ for visible gully detail). Thermal only if explicitly asked.
upgrade: Raise default to 10k+; auto-scale with resolution.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Mountain/Hills base layer
weakness: Docstring admits it's effectively a no-op — height is populated at state construction. A real macro pass should orchestrate tectonic base + regional distortion. Currently it's a validator masquerading as a generator.
upgrade: Actually call generate_world_heightmap from authoring intent here, so macro_world owns the base terrain, not state construction.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Analysis nodes (Slope/Convexity/Flow/Ridge)
weakness: supports_region_scope=False (always full-tile) which is correct but expensive; saliency_macro is a single scalar metric name rather than documented formula.
upgrade: Doc each channel's formula and add tests that compare against a Houdini reference.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Erosion2 / Houdini Erosion node
weakness: Default iterations 200-600 are low vs Gaea's 10k+; no explicit sediment transport conservation check; thermal uses only 6 iterations always.
upgrade: Expose iteration scaling with tile resolution; add mass-balance validation.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Asserts / UE validation framework
weakness: Truly minimal — no range checks (height bounds), no monotone drainage validation, no seam validation with neighbors.
upgrade: Add range + seam checks so 'validation' earns the name.

aaa_equivalent: Hydraulic geometry (Leopold-Maddock relation)
weakness: Scale factor is hardcoded default; no regional-calibration hook.
upgrade: Expose scale_factor via biome/climate params.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini flow-following / Gaea Flow Trace
weakness: Uses Python list for path — okay for single rivers; min_accumulation check '> 0' allows starting cell below threshold.
upgrade: Vectorize for bulk source processing.

aaa_equivalent: Priority-flood spill-point analysis (Gaea Lake node)
weakness: Naive pit detection (cell < all 8 neighbors) misses plateau lakes where multiple cells share min; spill_z is lowest neighbor, not true watershed spill.
upgrade: Use priority-flood algorithm (Barnes 2014) for real watershed spill computation.

aaa_equivalent: Heuristic waterfall finder
weakness: Only scans explicit river_path — won't find falls off the given path; best_drop is scalar, not rate (drop/horiz).
upgrade: Score by drop rate (drop/horiz_dist); also run independently on drainage raster.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 volumetric fog / Horizon Forbidden West localized fog sheets
weakness: Uniform random placement — no clustering around terrain features (god_rays should emit from tree gaps, fireflies near water). No occlusion/collision awareness. Volume area math for cone uses (h*0.5)^2 — arbitrary approximation.
upgrade: Accept heightmap + masks (ridge, water, canopy) and bias placement by feature affinity per volume type.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 volumetric proxy mesh
weakness: Icosphere is actually a dodecahedron arrangement (uses 12 verts but faces have errors — 'next_next if next_next <= segments else 1' in cone logic is suspicious and produces degenerate tris). Mesh resolution is too coarse for any close-up.
upgrade: Replace with proper icosphere subdivision (subdiv=1 gives 42 verts); fix cone face generation math.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 GPU stat scope estimator
weakness: Uses arbitrary thresholds (15/30/60/100) with no ms-budget grounding; assumes all particle/distortion volumes cost the same.
upgrade: Calibrate against actual GPU profile data from a reference scene.

aaa_equivalent: SpeedTree coastal kit / World Creator coast node
weakness: Uses hash-based pseudo-noise (_hash_noise) which is low-quality compared to OpenSimplex; style-specific elevation logic is hardcoded if/elif chain; cliff z-step is a discrete jump ('if land_factor > 0.3: z = base_elev * min(1,...)').
upgrade: Swap hash_noise for proper 2D OpenSimplex; smooth cliff z-profile; parameterize per-style in a config dict.

aaa_equivalent: Sea of Thieves wave-energy modeling / Houdini coastal exposure analysis
weakness: Hardcoded 5m decay constant for shoreline band; no fetch-length modeling.
upgrade: Parameterize decay; add fetch (distance from incoming wave source).

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Erosion applied at coast
weakness: hints_wave_dir=0.0 hardcoded — should pull from state hints; max 3m drop per pass is fixed.
upgrade: Thread wave dir through and parameterize max drop.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 water tidal mask
weakness: Linear taper; real intertidal zones have exponential drainage patterns.
upgrade: Exponential taper optional; integrate with wet_rock merge.

aaa_equivalent: Coastal geology pass
weakness: Doesn't actually mutate height even when coastal_erosion_enabled — it stores delta but carving is the caller's job. Metrics advertise tidal_coverage_fraction, good.
upgrade: Option to apply the delta directly like pass_waterfalls does with pool_delta.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Landscape editor full procedural pipeline
weakness: Massive handler (330+ lines) — hard to test; legacy path bypasses controller entirely (risk of divergent behavior); moisture_map logic only runs on legacy path.
upgrade: Extract into smaller orchestration functions; unify legacy and controller paths.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 World Partition tile authoring
weakness: Not inspected in full, but naming + params suggest proper world-tiled authoring.
upgrade: Assert seam validation against neighbor tiles after generation.

aaa_equivalent: World Machine single-shot world export
weakness: Not deeply inspected — but the dual (world vs tile) interface is a code-duplication risk.
upgrade: Share core with tile version via a core generator.

aaa_equivalent: Node-graph single-pass invocation
weakness: Relies on controller state living across calls — session-scoped state management not explicitly checked here.
upgrade: Add explicit session id param for multi-map workflows.

aaa_equivalent: Water-network-derived authoring in Horizon/RDR2
weakness: Still calls legacy generate_waterfall as fallback — deprecated geometry flagged but reachable. Functional_objects_materialized path has silent except.
upgrade: Remove legacy fallback entirely after grace period; stop swallowing materialize errors.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 World Partition seam stitcher
weakness: Docstring says 'Fallback seam stitcher' — suggests this is the backup path, real seams handled elsewhere; not inspected in full.
upgrade: Fold into the primary tile pipeline if possible.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape paint tool
weakness: Not inspected in full.
upgrade: Verify it respects biome palette and vertex-color splatmap contract.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini river carve along spline / Gaea River node
weakness: Uses bmesh per-vertex update which is slow on dense terrain; depth param interpretation has a normalization clamp.
upgrade: Batch vertex updates via foreach_set.

aaa_equivalent: Cave portal authoring handler
weakness: Not deeply inspected — grading by association with generate_cave_entrance_mesh (C).
upgrade: Upgrade geometry via terrain_caves path integration.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Landmass road tool / Gaea Path
weakness: Not deeply inspected for full signature; linear interpolation for segments (no spiral easing).
upgrade: Add clothoid easing; bank roads on grades.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Water System (SingleLayerWater shader + spline river)
weakness: Still falls back to simple grid when no path_points; many params (20+) suggests feature bloat; _build_terrain_world_height_sampler builds a new sampler per call.
upgrade: Cache sampler per terrain object.

aaa_equivalent: Lake-basin carving handler
weakness: Not deeply inspected.
upgrade: Verify basin carves respect protected zones and flow accumulation.

aaa_equivalent: Unity Terrain RAW 16-bit LE importer / UE Landscape import
weakness: Not deeply inspected.
upgrade: Add auto-validation of exported file (dims/endianness).

aaa_equivalent: Large-scale world gen (PCG World Partition)
weakness: Not deeply inspected.
upgrade: Confirm it exercises pass_coastline + pass_waterfalls + pass_caves in sequence.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 PCG vegetation / SpeedTree foliage pipeline
weakness: Exclusion-zone loop is O(objects * placements) — slow with many plots; billboard threshold is vertex-count based rather than screen-coverage aware.
upgrade: Spatial hash for exclusion; hysteresis on LOD switch.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 PCG prop scatter
weakness: Not deeply inspected.
upgrade: Ensure parity with vegetation scatter exclusions.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Chaos destructible
weakness: Not inspected; breakable meshes require fracture data typically not generable in Blender handler.
upgrade: Wire to a proper fracture pipeline (Cell Fracture addon).

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Spline SOP / UE5 Spline Component evaluation
weakness: Uses fixed uniform parameter sampling (no arc-length reparameterization), so point density clumps on tight curves and spreads on straights — AAA spline tooling samples by arc length for even corridor width.
upgrade: Add arc-length reparameterization pass (cumulative segment length lookup) and expose a tolerance-based adaptive subdivision for curvature.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini xyzdist() / UE Landscape Spline closest-point query
weakness: Brute-force O(N*M) scan of every polyline segment per vertex — AAA toolchains use spatial acceleration (BVH or uniform grid) and typically query in 3D not just XY.
upgrade: Build a segment AABB grid or BVH once per spline and query per-vertex; optionally offer 3D distance for vertical splines.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea/World Machine brush falloff curve / UE Landscape brush falloff presets
weakness: No custom curve/ramp support — AAA brush tools expose user-authored Bezier/AnimationCurve falloffs and additional presets (smoothstep, sphere, inverse-square).
upgrade: Accept an optional list-of-(t,value) control-point curve or smoothstep variant, and cache the four built-in shapes as numpy LUTs for vectorized callers.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Route / Houdini Heightfield Project Path / UE Landscape Spline Deform
weakness: Only modifies vertex Z without blending lateral shoulders into valley walls; 'smooth' mode degenerates to a weak pull-toward-spline-Z with no neighborhood averaging; no cross-section profile (flat bottom, bank angles, cutbanks).
upgrade: Add a user-provided cross-section curve (width vs depth) and a proper Laplacian smoothing pass for mode='smooth'; raymarch along spline normal to produce true trench/berm profiles.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Spline tool / Unity Terrain path carve
weakness: Operates on object-local coords but the pure-logic uses world-space spline points — no matrix_world transform, so splines break when the terrain is moved/scaled/rotated; no undo support or mesh-data integrity checks.
upgrade: Transform spline_points through obj.matrix_world.inverted() before calling compute_spline_deformation, and register with bpy.ops.ed.undo_push for editor undo.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea brush ops / UE Landscape sculpt brushes (raise/lower/smooth/noise)
weakness: Pure-Python double loop over the brush rect kills performance on 1024+ grids; 'smooth' uses a 3x3 box (not Gaussian); 'noise' is per-cell gauss (unbounded, non-spatially-coherent — AAA uses simplex/perlin at brush scale); 'stamp' replaces instead of blends.
upgrade: Vectorize via numpy masked ops, replace smooth with scipy gaussian_filter or separable 5x5 Gaussian, replace noise with simplex noise sampled at brush-scale frequency, and change stamp to add/blend with existing heights.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Combine node / Houdini Heightfield Layer merge
weakness: Nearest-neighbor resize produces blocky aliasing on mismatched layers; MULTIPLY is hardcoded as (1+lh) which is idiosyncratic; no OVERLAY/SCREEN/SOFT-LIGHT modes; no per-layer mask channel.
upgrade: Use bilinear/lanczos resize, add overlay/screen/soft-light, honor a per-layer mask, and expose an explicit multiply semantic (direct multiply vs 1+offset).

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape layer UI / Gaea layer panel
weakness: Every mutation re-serializes the full layer stack to a JSON string on an ID-property — will bloat .blend files and fail silently at ID-property size limits; flatten_layers assumes vertex order equals row-major reshape which breaks on non-grid meshes despite _detect_grid_dims; no undo integration.
upgrade: Persist layers as an external .npz per terrain keyed by hash, chunk large layers, and add depsgraph-aware undo.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Erosion brush / World Machine Erosion / Houdini Heightfield Erode
weakness: Hydraulic model has no sediment/water channels — it is a slope-redistribution stencil with a hardcoded 0.1 factor, nothing like the Mei-Hill or particle-based hydraulic solvers used by Gaea/Houdini; wind erosion is literally gauss() with fixed +X deposit; thermal duplicates apply_thermal_erosion weakly; pure-Python nested loops make it unusable for brushes over ~64px.
upgrade: Replace hydraulic with a particle-based droplet solver (Hans-Beyer) or MEI full-shallow-water with sediment/water/flux fields; vectorize with numpy; add anisotropic wind with a direction vector.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Erosion sculpt brush
weakness: Inherits all weaknesses of compute_erosion_brush (toy hydraulic/wind); no undo; blocks Blender main thread during slow pure-Python erosion; doesn't rebuild normals after displacement so shading looks wrong.
upgrade: Move compute into a numpy/numba path, call mesh.calc_normals_split or bmesh normal update post-mutation, and add a progress/cancel mechanism.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Heightfield Flow / Gaea Flow node
weakness: Pure-Python triple-nested loop makes it prohibitive for >256 grids (minutes on 512); D8 has known artifacts (parallel channel stripes) — AAA uses D-infinity (Tarboton) or multiple-flow-direction; no pit-filling pre-pass so internal pits create spurious basins; returns .tolist() which balloons memory.
upgrade: Vectorize flow direction with numpy roll tricks, add a Planchon-Darboux pit-fill pre-pass, offer D-inf / MFD alternatives, and return numpy arrays optionally.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Heightfield Erode Thermal / Gaea Thermal node
weakness: Pure-Python double loop is 100x slower than a numpy vectorized version; uses 4-neighborhood only (no diagonals) so scree fans look axis-aligned; no angle-of-repose per-material layer; returns .tolist() blowing memory for 512+ maps.
upgrade: Vectorize with numpy shift operations (np.roll + max), add 8-neighborhood with sqrt(2) distance scaling, and expose per-cell talus from a mask for multi-material slopes.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Stamp / Houdini Heightfield Noise/Stamp library
weakness: All built-in stamps are trivially analytic radial functions — a real crater has an asymmetric rim with ejecta rays and a central peak; a mesa has fracture patterns; these look like math primitives, not terrain features; fixed 64px resolution truncates detail.
upgrade: Replace built-ins with real heightmap tiles (PNG/EXR library) — craters with ejecta blankets, mesas with ridge noise overlay, plus FFT-resampling to arbitrary resolution; keep analytic shapes only as fallbacks.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape import height stamp / Gaea Stamp apply
weakness: The blend math `edge_falloff*(1-falloff) + edge_falloff*falloff` algebraically collapses to just edge_falloff — the falloff parameter is inert; nearest-integer stamp sampling (no bilinear); additive only (no min/max/replace modes); rotation is unsupported.
upgrade: Fix the degenerate blend formula (lerp between hard and soft edges properly), add bilinear stamp sampling, expose add/max/replace/multiply blend modes, and add a rotation parameter.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Stamp tool
weakness: Inherits the inert-falloff bug and primitive stamp shapes from its dependencies; hardcoded 64x64 stamp resolution; no rotation; uses object-local terrain_size from obj.dimensions which breaks when mesh is transformed.
upgrade: Plumb resolution/rotation/blend-mode params, transform position through inverse matrix_world, and fix the falloff degenerate blend.

aaa_equivalent: UE Foliage/Blueprint SnapToGround / Unity Terrain.SampleHeight
weakness: Single downward ray with no fallback (misses on overhangs/cliffs); normal alignment replaces the entire rotation_euler, destroying any authored yaw; no multi-sample averaging for stable placement on noisy terrain; no parallelization for large object lists.
upgrade: Preserve object yaw by only tilting to normal around the vertical; add multi-sample footprint averaging; offer a fallback raycast from object centroid and an up-ray option for ceiling snap.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Flatten brush / Gaea Terrace flat zone
weakness: Circular only (name says 'zone' but no ellipse or rectangle support); blend is isotropic and cannot match building footprint shapes; seed parameter is unused (documented 'reserved').
upgrade: Accept (radius_x, radius_y) or a polygon mask; add optional noise-perturbed blend edge using seed; support rectangular/OBB footprints aligned to building rotation.

aaa_equivalent: Batch flatten across multiple building footprints
weakness: Sequential application means later zones fight earlier ones in overlap regions (last-writer-wins) — AAA batch flatten resolves overlaps via max/min/priority or unified mask; no overlap warning; O(Z*H*W) with Z zones, no spatial bucketing.
upgrade: Build a combined mask with per-cell priority/blend and apply in one pass, or expose an overlap-resolution mode (max/min/weighted).

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Flatten tool on an arbitrary mesh
weakness: Grid binning loses sub-cell detail and reintroduces aliasing; fetches delta via grid[row_idx, col_idx] nearest-neighbor (no bilinear); target_height normalization recomputes z_min/z_max on the binned grid not the vertices; two dead `_ = max(..., 1e-6)` lines signal unfinished normalization logic; ellipse radius_x/radius_y collapses to a single averaged flat_radius so non-circular zones aren't actually supported despite the param surface.
upgrade: Use bilinear interpolation when sampling delta back to vertices, honor radius_x vs radius_y as a true ellipse in the pure-logic call, remove dead code, and compute target normalization from the real vertex Z range.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini curve-based cave authoring / UE5 Voxel Farm cave curve
weakness: All paths are 2D polylines with simple trigonometric jitter — no branching, no chamber nodes, no inclination variation within archetype.
upgrade: Add branching (Y-splits), chamber hubs along path, per-archetype branch probability.

aaa_equivalent: Voxel carve along spline (UE5 Voxel Plugin)
weakness: Flat 2D footprint — heightmap can't represent true 3D caves (the delta only lowers terrain surface). For real caves this needs voxel/mesh-boolean backend.
upgrade: Wire through to a voxel field (terrain_advanced) so caves are true 3D volumes.

aaa_equivalent: Skyrim/ESO cave portal kit
weakness: Framing rocks are just world positions + radius — no actual shape variation, no per-archetype material hint.
upgrade: Specify rock asset kit per archetype + size variance + biased noise for position.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 PCG debris scatter
weakness: No clustering (debris typically piles), no collision with entrance frame; all debris same type.
upgrade: Add Poisson clustering + per-cluster type.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 wetness mask shader driver
weakness: Linear falloff — real damp patterns follow seepage paths (downslope preference).
upgrade: Bias falloff downslope of path.

aaa_equivalent: UE PCG cave authoring graph
weakness: Only processes scene-read supplied entrances (no auto-discovery from heightmap features); cell_count recomputed per loop.
upgrade: Add auto-entrance detection using cliff-edge + slope + basin proximity when scene_read is empty.

aaa_equivalent: MCP handler shim over cave authoring
weakness: Uses synthetic state builder — real scene_read may not be present; chamber mesh is a simple box loft.
upgrade: Prefer actual scene state over synthetic; richer chamber mesh.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini Heightfield carve + side tributary erosion (e.g. RDR2 Grand Canyon, Uncharted Lost Legacy canyons)
weakness: Canyon is a straight rectilinear trench along X with only mild y-offset wall noise; no meander, no talus slopes, no stratified horizontal rock layers, and 'side caves' are only metadata dicts with zero actual mesh carved into the walls.
upgrade: Build canyon centerline via meandering spline, carve walls from a base heightmap with multi-octave stratified erosion, generate real boolean cave voids at each side cave, and add scree/debris cones at wall bases.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West / Genshin waterfall with volumetric water plume, pool caustics, and mist VFX; Gaea water-carving layer.
weakness: Ledges are literally single quads (no side/bottom faces), pool is a crude 16-sided fan triangle disc with no lip or undercut, 'cave behind' is pure metadata with no geometry carved, and there is no water mesh, no plunge basin curvature, and no erosion behind/below the falls.
upgrade: Generate real boxed ledges with front undercuts, carve a real cave void behind the flow with SDF boolean, build a volumetric water plume mesh (tapered prism, not plane) and a contoured plunge pool with distinct lip, and output mist emitter positions.

aaa_equivalent: Uncharted / Tomb Raider climbable cliff with ledge kit, or UE Landscape Layer Blend with overhang tool.
weakness: Base cliff is still a single planar heightfield tilted at the top (not true overhangs with undercut), cave entrances are metadata only with no holes punched in the face, and ledge ribbon is a flat two-vertex strip with no thickness or railings/handholds.
upgrade: Use a displaced volumetric slab (front + top + underside stitched) so overhang becomes a real shelf, boolean-carve cave entrances through the face, and extrude the ledge into a 3D walkable shelf with chamfered edge.

aaa_equivalent: Far Cry/Witcher 3 bog biome with hummock stamps, standing water masks, and island dry-zone classification.
weakness: Resolution scales as size/2 (so a 50m swamp is only 25x25 = 625 quads = ~2m quads) which is too coarse for AAA; no channel/river carving, no peat/hammock micro-morphology, and water is tagged via material only — there is no actual water plane mesh.
upgrade: Raise resolution to sub-meter, carve drainage channels with hydraulic erosion pass, emit a separate water surface mesh aligned to water_level, and output root/reed scatter masks instead of just material IDs.

aaa_equivalent: Real natural arch (Delicate Arch / Mesa Arch) as sculpted erosion of sandstone block, or Houdini Voronoi-fracture + erosion.
weakness: The arch is a swept elliptical tube (torus-arc) with single-sample noise per ring segment — that is the archetypal 'stretched torus' approach called out by the rubric; real natural arches are eroded rock masses with flat tops, scalloped undersides, and asymmetric pillar bases, none of which are modeled. Pillars are simple tapered 4-vert boxes.
upgrade: Start from a solid rock mass (blockout box), boolean-subtract an elliptical tunnel, then apply per-layer strata displacement and wind-erosion noise on the underside so the shape reads as eroded sandstone, not a bent pipe.

aaa_equivalent: Yellowstone-style travertine terrace (RDR2 Cotorra Springs, Horizon hot springs) with layered sinter steps.
weakness: Pool is a fan-triangulated flat disc (no concavity toward center despite the comment), terraces are only 3 rigid concentric rings of equal width (not scalloped basins with pour-lips), and there is no water surface mesh, no steam vent placement, and the vent cone is just 3 rings.
upgrade: Model terraces as stacked basin polygons with irregular pour-lips carved per tier, add a real water surface inside each basin, generate steam/sulfur plume emitter points, and vary terrace counts by pool_radius.

aaa_equivalent: Tomb Raider/Uncharted cenote or Sima de las Cotorras with vertical walls, vegetation shelves, and water pool bottom.
weakness: Walls are still rotationally symmetric (only 15% narrowing at bottom, no undercuts or bell shape), rubble boxes are axis-aligned and identical topology, the bottom cave is metadata-only with no actual opening cut into the wall, and there is no water/vegetation shelf despite sinkholes typically having both.
upgrade: Allow non-axisymmetric radius profile (bell or hourglass), boolean-carve the bottom cave into the wall mesh, scatter rocks with varied topology and rotation, and add a mid-depth vegetation shelf ring.

aaa_equivalent: Avatar/Horizon floating islands or Zelda TOTK sky islands; Houdini Voronoi-fractured rock clusters.
weakness: Chain 'links' are open cylindrical shafts stacked vertically (not interlocked torus rings), rocks are fundamentally noisy spheres with no sharp fractured planes or crystalline protrusions, undersides look identical to tops (same material differentiation is purely tag-based), and there is no island flat top / grass zone typical of fantasy float rocks.
upgrade: Replace sphere base with Voronoi-fractured polyhedra giving flat facets, differentiate top via flattened cap + grass mask, make chain links actual torus primitives interlocking at 90-degree alternation, and add crystal vein mesh geometry rather than just material tag.

aaa_equivalent: God of War Ragnarok ice caves / Horizon FW Cauldrons with volumetric ice, parallax refraction, and icicle clusters.
weakness: Stalactite material banding uses `kt` variable that is actually the OUTER loop counter `k` from a previous loop (variable captured incorrectly — bug: `kt` in the mat_indices block references the last stalactite's last ring k/cone_rings, not current face position), 'refraction zones' are randomly sampled metadata disconnected from the actual curvature classification applied to faces, ice wall is a flat displaced plane (no thickness), and there is no floor/stalagmite, no pool, no volumetric ice.
upgrade: Fix the kt-scoping bug so banding tracks current ring properly; extrude the ice wall into a volume with frosted interior; add matching stalagmites and frozen pool mesh; derive refraction_zones from the actual high-curvature face centers rather than random sampling.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Burning Shores lava channels or Kilauea reference with pahoehoe crust folds and incandescent fissures.
weakness: Flow is still a single-strip ribbon — no branching, no pillow/tube morphology, no solidification fingers; crust edges are symmetric with simple linear height profile, no a'a vs pahoehoe variation; lava surface is the same continuous grid as the rock banks with no lip or embankment discontinuity; heat zones are uniformly distributed along t with no flow-physics grounding.
upgrade: Replace ribbon with a 2D flow-accumulation field producing branching channels, model crust as a separate floating shell above a lower hot-lava surface (two meshes) with broken crust patches, and derive heat_zones from channel-width narrowings/drop points instead of uniform sampling.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape layer slope/height auto-assign
weakness: Modulo face index distribution is deterministic but visually linear — no spatial coherence (adjacent faces can flip material).
upgrade: Use spatial hash (face center) with blue noise for variance.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Vertex-color splatmap (4-channel)
weakness: Static zone->channel weights ignore biome-specific preferences (a swamp shouldn't give .6 grass + 0 rock uniformly); no smoothing across vertices.
upgrade: Pull zone weights per-biome from palette; Laplacian smooth.

aaa_equivalent: Corrupted-zone overlay shader
weakness: Uniform tint — no per-vertex corruption variance; hardcoded purple (0.12, 0.04, 0.14) from 'linear sRGB' comment.
upgrade: Sample corruption_map per-vertex for spatial variance.

aaa_equivalent: Witcher 3 / ESO biome-boundary splat blend
weakness: Axis-aligned boundary only (x or y); _simple_noise_2d is a hash-based approximation, not true Simplex; amplitude is in world units but scale is normalized.
upgrade: Support arbitrary polyline boundary + OpenSimplex noise.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 Landscape auto-material RGBA (grass/dirt/rock/special)
weakness: Linear slope thresholds; no anisotropic lighting hint; moisture tint is limited (>0.7 or <0.3).
upgrade: Soften slope transition with smoothstep; expose moisture curve.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini HDA deterministic seed chaining / UE5 PCG seed domain
weakness: JSON encoding adds overhead vs a direct bytes hash, but negligible.
upgrade: Cache on intent to avoid re-hashing per-pass in tight loops if needed.

aaa_equivalent: UE PCG node registration
weakness: Hard-coded 4 passes; no way to compose profiles.
upgrade: Load profile from YAML to support game-specific pass graphs.

aaa_equivalent: ZBrush/Mudbox brush falloff curve (customizable curve editor)
weakness: Hard-coded set of 4 curves with no user-definable curve editor, no root/inverse-sharp/middle/gaussian options, and the clamp to 1.5 silently allows out-of-range input where AAA tools expose an editable 2D spline.
upgrade: Replace with a sampled 1D curve LUT driven by a user-editable spline (bezier/catmull) plus common presets (gauss, sharper, root, constant, custom), matching Blender/ZBrush brush curve UX.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape brush footprint / Houdini heightfield mask by radius
weakness: O(N) linear scan over every vertex with no spatial acceleration (KD-tree/grid/BVH), XY-only so projects wrong on sloped terrain, no pressure/tilt/azimuth, no anisotropic (elliptical) brush, no alpha-texture mask, and no stroke dab spacing - AAA tools use screen-space projection along the view ray with a spatial index.
upgrade: Add KD-tree/spatial grid accel, ray-project the brush onto the surface (not XY plane), support pressure curve + elliptical shape + alpha-image mask + stroke spacing, and compute weight over geodesic distance for steep slopes.

aaa_equivalent: ZBrush Standard/Inflate brush, UE Landscape Sculpt (raise)
weakness: Displaces purely along world Z with no surface-normal option, no accumulation curve / per-dab falloff, no max-height clamp, no layer/undo stack, no pressure-sensitive strength, and no noise/jitter - an AAA raise brush offsets along averaged normal with stroke accumulation and clamps.
upgrade: Offset along smoothed vertex normal (toggle normal vs Z), add per-stroke accumulation/clamp, pressure curve, optional noise modulation, and feed into a layered height buffer for non-destructive sculpting.

aaa_equivalent: ZBrush Standard (inverted) / UE Landscape Sculpt (lower)
weakness: Just a sign-flip of raise - no normal-aligned direction, no floor/minimum clamp, no distinct 'dig' behavior (AAA dig brushes carve along inverse-normal with a sharper falloff and terrain-floor clamp), and shares all of raise's gaps.
upgrade: Share a single directional-displacement kernel with raise, expose direction enum (UP/DOWN/NORMAL/INV_NORMAL), add min-height clamp, pressure, and dig-shape option.

aaa_equivalent: ZBrush Smooth brush, Blender sculpt Smooth (Laplacian/surface/enhance-detail)
weakness: Only smooths Z (not full 3D position), uniform weighting rather than cotangent/area weights (causes shrinkage on irregular meshes), single Jacobi iteration per call (no iteration count), no Taubin lambda/mu shrinkage compensation, no detail-preserving smooth, no boundary handling - ZBrush/Blender offer Laplacian, Surface, Enhance-Detail, Taubin, and relax modes.
upgrade: Add iterations param, support cotangent weights, Taubin lambda/mu to prevent shrinkage, a surface-smooth mode that preserves XY and only relaxes along normal, plus relax-topology and enhance-detail variants.

aaa_equivalent: ZBrush Flatten/Planar/Trim Dynamic, UE Landscape Flatten (with eye-dropper)
weakness: Flattens to unweighted mean Z of affected verts (not a fitted plane), ignores brush weights in the average (bias toward edge verts), no user-set target height / eye-dropper pick, no plane-from-first-contact 'trim' mode, no angle/slope constraint - AAA flatten brushes plane-fit via least-squares and offer 'flatten to target', 'ramp', 'contrast' modes.
upgrade: Compute a weighted least-squares plane from the affected verts, expose modes (average / first-hit / user-target / plane-fit), add contrast-blur parameter and ramp/slope constraint.

aaa_equivalent: World Machine/Gaea stamp macro, Houdini heightfield stamp, ZBrush Alpha stamp, UE Landscape Erosion/Stamp brush
weakness: Nearest-neighbor sampling only (no bilinear/bicubic) causing blocky artifacts, axis-aligned square footprint inside a circular brush, no rotation / scale / flip, no blend modes (add/max/min/subtract/replace), no height remap curve, no wrap/tile, no masked alpha channel - AAA stamps support rotation, 8+ blend ops, bicubic sampling, and remap curves.
upgrade: Add bilinear/bicubic sampling, rotation/scale/flip of the stamp, blend modes (add/max/min/replace/multiply/subtract), height remap curve, tile/wrap option, and a separate mask channel; decouple stamp footprint from circular brush weight.

aaa_equivalent: UE Landscape Sculpt mode / Blender Sculpt operator / ZBrush stroke dispatch
weakness: Not a true stroke system - a single dab per call with no stroke spacing / path / smoothing-between-dabs, full mesh read/write every call (O(N) each), no undo stack / layer, no symmetry (X/Y/radial), no multires / sculpt-mode integration, no mask/vertex-group support, no normal/position updates beyond Z, no dirty-rect optimization - AAA sculpt dispatchers stream strokes, write only touched verts, push to an undo stack, and support symmetry + mask + layers.
upgrade: Accept a stroke (list of samples + pressure), build/maintain a vertex KD-tree + dirty-vert set across dabs, add symmetry planes, mask/vertex-group weighting, undo layer stack, and an option to modify XYZ along normal; batch bmesh writes per stroke not per dab.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West river-lip detector / Houdini flow-based feature tagging
weakness: Python nested for-loop — slow on >1k grids; confidence is linear blend (could use logistic).
upgrade: Vectorize with numpy argmax over D8 stack and np.where thresholds.

aaa_equivalent: Houdini cascade solver / RDR2 waterfall chain authoring
weakness: Plateau detection is heuristic (plateau_hits>=2); outflow cap of 32 cells may truncate long cascades; no actual overhang geometry — chain is centerline only.
upgrade: Add overhang detection at lip (undercut carving), longer outflow cap, multi-drop merging with confluence.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea Pool/Basin carve
weakness: Circular footprint; real plunge pools have directional scour (downstream elongation) from jet impact.
upgrade: Elliptical footprint oriented along outflow_direction_rad; erode lip downstream.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea River/Channel carve
weakness: Square-kernel iteration per waypoint (Python double loop) — slow; linear taper rather than parabolic; no meander.
upgrade: Vectorize with scipy.ndimage.distance_transform_edt across path mask; add meander.

aaa_equivalent: Horizon Forbidden West localized volumetric fog
weakness: Perfect circle — wind direction not modeled; Python inner loops.
upgrade: Bias mist downwind from chain's outflow vector; vectorize.

aaa_equivalent: UE5 water foam mask
weakness: Same radial profile as mist; no foam along plunge path itself, only pool.
upgrade: Add foam along full plunge_path and outflow with turbulence-derived intensity.

aaa_equivalent: Custom AAA mesh-contract validator
weakness: Only checks profile params, not actual mesh generated — relies on downstream to honor profile.
upgrade: Round-trip check: generate mesh, measure vert density, feed back into validation.

aaa_equivalent: Gaea hydrology graph node / RDR2 river pass
weakness: Caps at 16 chains (soft limit); wet_rock merging uses max instead of accumulate.
upgrade: Parameterize cap; consider alpha-blend wet_rock accumulation.
